description: Changes who can see a game. public: anyone can open it and it shows up in the site's Explore gallery. private: only the owner sees it; needs a paid plan, and on the free plan the call fails with a message to show the user. Doesn't touch the sounds or spend credits, and calling it again with the same value changes nothing. Only call it when the user asks to lock or open the game.

visibility.description: public (in Explore) or private (owner only, paid plan).

name: set_game_visibility
title: Lock or open game
